description.narrative:
The Periferia Viva Program was launched by the Federal Government as part of the New Growth Acceleration Program for Favela Urbanization (Novo PAC – Programa de Aceleração do Crescimento para Urbanização de Favelas). The objective of the Periferia Viva Program is to coordinate public policies and strengthen grassroots initiatives in peripheral territories, aiming to improve living conditions, particularly in the program’s key areas: urban infrastructure, social facilities, social and community empowerment, innovation, technology, and opportunities.
As the initial phase of the program's implementation in the territory, an Action Plan must be developed as a participatory planning tool. This plan will define the actions, urban interventions, and necessary policies for the territory receiving public investments. The objective is to establish, through social participation, priority actions, urban interventions, and necessary public policies in an integrated and cross-cutting manner. This approach aims to gradually address and resolve the vulnerabilities in the territory. The chosen territory for intervention is “Complexo da Maré” (Maré Complex), an area consisted of favelas and social housing complexes, including Vila do Pinheiro, Parque União, Nova Holanda, Parque Maré, Baixa do Sapateiro, Timbau, Pata Choca, Salsa e Merengue, Avenida Canal, Vila do João, Bento Ribeiro Dantas, Conjunto Esperança, Nova Maré, and Parque Roquete Pinto.
Since 2019, UN-Habitat has been active in Maré through the Territórios Sociais Program, a municipal initiative that identifies families in social vulnerability and connects them to public services. This experience in the territory and ability to engage with local actors aims to ensure that the objectives of the Action Plan development are achieved.
To achieve the proposed goal of improve water and sanitation infrastructure and enhance access to basic services for residents in prioritized territories of Complexo da Maré, based on community-identified priorities, this project includes comprehensive communication and advocacy campaign, and social participation designed to foster sustainable urban development aligned with the SDGs and the New Urban Agenda, as follows:
Outcome 1 – Increased decision-making influence of prioritized communities in the Complexo da Maré to improve urban infrastructure and local environmental quality
• Output 1.1: Participatory Process Organizational Plan for the Periferia Viva Program - Maré • Output 1.2: Technical-community analysis report on the Periferia Viva Program - Maré • Output 1.3: Document with Action Strategy Planning for the Periferia Viva Program - Maré • Output 1.4: Report on the preparation of projects for the Periferia Viva Program - Maré • Output 1.5: Consolidated Action Plan and Institutional Arrangement for the Periferia Viva Program - Maré
